candidates.name: Sentence centre, spread and tail organisation
candidates.graph_prompt: Inspect the mean/median sentence-length band with IQR progression. The final Human-minus-AI following average is positive, with recipes reversing, wiki near zero and strong reddit contribution. Nonlinear mean/IQR and median/IQR pairs discriminate better than the joint three-member score. CV and maximum length remain contextual features.
candidates.status_text: Final limited three-member following and mean-response gain supported; five-member necessity and complete scatter not established

candidates.name: Clause configuration and depth progression
candidates.graph_prompt: Does the coupled clause band and its depth progression remain more ordered in Human than ChatGPT across genres? A refined three-member clause-organisation/depth lead. Human often shows coordinated clause movement and depth progression; ChatGPT is less ordered in several domains. Abstracts, news and recipes are important exceptions. Shared ccomp counts, ties and sentence denominators need further qualification. Mean child count was removed because it is redundant with sentence-token span in this subset.
candidates.status_text: Final average ordered component supported, with news reversal and near-zero poetry; complete geometry unconfirmed

candidates.name: Local adverb and advmod band width
candidates.graph_prompt: Inspect the adverb/advmod band and its local spread. Sentence length is optional 3D context; the frozen S01 endpoint uses the two modifier-band features. See the fixed-curve all-genre atlas below.
candidates.status_text: Positive average local width contrast; all eight point estimates positive, with uncertain poetry/reddit effects. A necessary third member is not claimed

candidates.name: Modifier bands and grammatical sequencing
candidates.graph_prompt: Inspect the adverb/advmod band at shared raw positions. Its final local residual-width point estimate is wider for Human in every genre, with poetry/reddit uncertainty and review support limits. Entropy, conjunction and subordination remain context; a five-member relationship is not established.
candidates.status_text: S01 two-member local thickness component supported on average; remaining members exploratory

candidates.name: Coordinated expansion and maximum-depth separation
candidates.graph_prompt: Read the complete four-member configuration. Sentence span supplies the ordering coordinate. Arc extent and mean tree depth form the moving band. Maximum tree depth is the fourth member: does it stay with that band, flatten or peel away as the configuration expands? Human profiles track more closely in several domains; some AI profiles separate toward the upper span region. Abstracts and poetry show more similar movement; recipes, reddit and wiki need careful qualification. This is a joint-geometry lead, with no formula or recurrence claim yet. The CSV name avg_clause_length averages full spaCy sentence-token lengths in this extractor.
candidates.status_text: Global following contrast inconclusive on fresh data; local geometry remains a development question

candidates.name: Sentence and paragraph organisation comparison
candidates.graph_prompt: Inspect sentence span, paragraph span and paragraph-count layers as one configuration. Domain-specific strips and layers occur, but the proposed common Human/AI band difference did not recur consistently in the all-domain views. Retained as a comparison and counterexample, not an established pattern.

candidates.name: Character and lexical entropy organisation comparison
candidates.graph_prompt: Does the character-entropy band carry a different collective content/POS-entropy progression in the two classes? Both classes show a rising character-entropy band and similar content-entropy progression. A local fan in books does not establish recurrence; compact shared-scale clouds can be broad in relative-order coordinates.
candidates.status_text: Comparison question; no distinct recurring interaction established

candidates.name: Function-word organisation and grammatical balance comparison
candidates.graph_prompt: As the function-word band changes, do pronouns and nouns form distinct joint branches or trade-off configurations? Human recipes and abstracts show more ordered density/run movement, but poetry and reddit retain coordination in both classes and wiki is broad in both. No common four-member grammatical branch is established.
candidates.status_text: Comparison question; no distinct recurring interaction established

candidates.name: Word-shape envelope comparison
candidates.graph_prompt: Is there a distinct joint envelope or departure among length, dispersion, syllables and long-word share? Both classes share a rising word-shape envelope. Band scatter varies by genre. Narrow shared-coordinate AI clouds alone do not establish a different four-member interaction.
candidates.status_text: Comparison question; no distinct recurring interaction established

candidates.name: Sentence and punctuation organisation comparison
candidates.graph_prompt: Does the inverse span/period configuration combine with overall punctuation and commas in a class-specific branch or envelope? Both classes show inverse sentence-span/period movement. Apparent stronger constraints in some AI panels reverse or weaken in books, recipes, reddit and wiki. No recurring punctuation/comma branch is established.
candidates.status_text: Comparison question; no distinct recurring interaction established

candidates.name: Coupling between grammatical and dependency bands comparison
candidates.graph_prompt: Do the adjective and adverb bands move together or separate as a complete four-member configuration? The adjective and adverb bands count overlapping POS/dependency roles. Their joint four-member configuration does not show one clear recurring class contrast in this pass.
candidates.status_text: Comparison question; no distinct recurring interaction established

candidates.name: Vocabulary, repetition and entropy
candidates.graph_prompt: Does the type/singleton band connect to the repetition/diversity configuration through a different entropy progression in the two classes? Shared type/singleton band; repetition/diversity following is often clearer in Human abstracts, poetry and wiki, but news is a counterexample and the entropy link is mixed.

candidates.name: Nominal organisation and lexical participation
candidates.graph_prompt: Do nominal/compound organisation and pronoun/verb diversity share distinct depth regimes or departures? Noun/compound participation generally rises together in both classes. AI poetry is less ordered; pronoun/verb-diversity projections remain broad rather than a recurring connected configuration.

candidates.name: Character repertoire and word organisation
candidates.graph_prompt: Does character repertoire combine with whitespace and word-size dispersion through a class-specific trigram-entropy geometry? Both classes share entropy/repertoire progression and inverse whitespace/word-dispersion organisation. Scatter and occupancy differ, with genre reversals.
candidates.status_text: SHARED_GEOMETRY; no recurring distinctive five-member pattern established

candidates.name: Morphology and nominal/verbal organisation
candidates.graph_prompt: Does word size connect nominal morphology and verbal morphology/diversity in a recurring class-specific configuration? Sparse suffix stacks and broad nominal/verbal clouds do not reveal a recurring connected word-size configuration.

candidates.name: Stance and qualification organisation
candidates.graph_prompt: Do qualification and certainty/discourse configurations carry distinct recurring negation regimes? Tied and zero stance values dominate the linked panels. Changing zero occupancy is insufficient evidence of a collective interaction.

candidates.name: Word size, sentence variation and sentence openings
candidates.graph_prompt: Does the word-size band connect to variation/opening organisation through a different punctuation configuration? AI syllable/character word-size bands are tighter in several genres, while recipes reverses and poetry is qualified. Sentence-opening and variation projections are broad or discretely tied.
